items.title: 機率表太大，關係也不能全刪
items.concept: 維度詛咒與稀疏依賴的折衷
items.source_meaning: A full distribution of l binary variables has 2^l−1 free parameters. Six need63; twenty1,048,575. Fully independent binary variables need l. Sparse BN can save parameters only if the independence assumptions fit; no guarantee sparse always right.

Storyboard: P1 student faces six binary switches and a giant cabinet: 「6 個二元變數，要估 63 個參數！」 P2 cabinet expands beyond the room, board 「20 個變數：1,048,575 個參數」 and student 「資料快不夠了！」 P3 robot erases ALL links between SIX plain dots (exactly six unconnected dots) and says 「完全獨立，卻可能漏掉關聯」. items.title: 拆成連乘，不代表省參數
items.concept: 鏈鎖規則與全部先前條件
items.source_meaning: The chain rule is an identity with no independence assumption: p(a,b,c)=p(a)p(b|a)p(c|a,b). It reorganizes a joint distribution but doesn't remove free parameters.

items.title: 真正省下來的是父集合
items.concept: 父節點子集合與條件獨立假設
items.source_meaning: For a topological order, assume p(x_i|all predecessors)=p(x_i|parents). Use original node x5 has only parent x4. This doesn't imply x5 marginally independent of all other nodes.
